description: Pull observations across one or more studies and pivot them into a germplasm × trait matrix materialized as a canvas dataframe. Returns a dataframe handle (read it with brapi_dataframe_describe and brapi_dataframe_query) plus a summary of dimensions and aggregate method. Long-form output is suitable for downstream GROUP BY analysis by study, germplasm, or variable. A study whose pull fails is named in warnings and the rest still build the matrix; the call fails only when every study failed.

aggregate.description: How to aggregate replicate observations (multiple readings of the same variable on the same germplasm). `mean` and `median` attempt numeric conversion and skip non-numeric values (e.g. categorical traits). `first` keeps the first value seen. `all` keeps every replicate as a separate row (produces long-form output even when shape is "wide"). Default: `mean`.

alias.description: Connection alias. Omit to use alias `default`. An alias registered via brapi_connect works, and so does one the server has a URL configured for (a built-in alias, an operator-configured alias, or `default` on a deployment with a default server), which connects on first use. Calls that used a non-default alias must pass that same alias here.

extraFilters.description: Extra BrAPI filters forwarded verbatim. Valid keys vary by endpoint; brapi_describe_filters enumerates them. Named params on this tool take precedence on conflict.

germplasm.description: Optional subset of germplasmDbIds to include. Omit to include all germplasm found in the queried studies.

loadLimit.description: Cap on matching observations collected per study. Omit for the deployment default. A study that stops at it is reported as truncated.

shape.description: Matrix shape. `wide` — one row per germplasm, one column per variable, cell = aggregated value. `long` — one row per observation with columns: germplasmDbId, observationVariableDbId, studyDbId, value, replicateIndex. When `aggregate:"all"` is combined with `shape:"wide"`, the output falls back to long form with a replicateIndex column.

studies.description: studyDbIds to include in the matrix. At least one is required — the tool is study-anchored to avoid full-table scans.

variables.description: Optional subset of observationVariableDbIds to include. Omit to include all variables found in the queried studies.

name: brapi_build_phenotype_matrix

aggregate.description: Aggregation applied to replicate observations (wide shape only). `all` keeps one row per replicate.

cap.description: Per-study cap on matching observations that was applied.

coverage.description: Collection coverage, independent of the number of contributing studies.

discoveryLimited.description: True when generic study discovery reached its bound; additional studies may exist.

partial.description: True when failed, truncated, or unprocessed work leaves coverage incomplete.

scan.description: Scoped-unit scan coverage; unseen studies are unknown after an incomplete walk.

complete.description: Whether the scoped unit walk exhausted its authoritative total.

reason.description: Bound or failure that stopped the unit walk.

scannedUnits.description: Raw upstream units examined, including repeated IDs.

totalUnits.description: Upstream raw unit total, when reported.

studies.description: Per-study outcomes in requested or encounter order.

observationCount.description: Matching observations collected for this study.

reason.description: Why collection failed or remained incomplete.

status.description: Outcome of collecting this study; partial may contain observations.

studyDbId.description: Requested study, or a study encountered in scoped units.

dataframe.description: The matrix, staged; absent when no observations were found. Long-form columns: germplasmDbId, observationVariableDbId, studyDbId, value, replicateIndex. Wide-form columns: germplasmDbId, germplasmName, then one per variable (see variableLegend).

columnLegend.description: Sanitized column name → original upstream key, present only when a column was renamed to be SQL-safe (e.g. `end` → `end_`). SQL uses the sanitized names.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 time the dataframe metadata is purged; copy rows out before, or re-run the producing tool.

maxRows.description: Row cap that ended the pull, present only when that cap fired.

tableName.description: Table name for brapi_dataframe_describe and brapi_dataframe_query.

totalCount.description: Upstream-reported row total, when known; can exceed rowCount.

truncated.description: True when the dataframe holds less than the upstream reports: a cap, failed page, deadline, or short upstream ended the pull, or it was skipped. warnings says which. Absent otherwise.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_not_found`: An uncaught BrAPI data request answered HTTP 404. `upstream_rate_limited`: An uncaught BrAPI data request exhausted retries after HTTP 429. `unknown_alias`: No connection is registered under the requested alias, and the server has no base URL configured for it to connect on first use. `auth_token_exchange_failed`: Connecting the alias on first use, the SGN or OAuth token exchange against the BrAPI /token endpoint failed. `auth_no_access_token`: Connecting the alias on first use, the token endpoint answered without returning an access token. `capability_discovery_unavailable`: Neither /serverinfo nor /calls listed any call, and at least one of them timed out, was unreachable, or answered 429 or a 5xx other than 501, so nothing was cached. `upstream_unauthorized`: The BrAPI server answered HTTP 401: it requires credentials, or rejected the ones sent. `upstream_forbidden`: The BrAPI server answered HTTP 403: the credentials sent, or their absence, lack access. `alias_base_url_invalid`: The base URL configured on the server for this alias is not an absolute http(s) URL, or carries credentials. `private_address_blocked`: The base URL configured for this alias, or its token URL, is on a private or reserved address this server may not reach. `dialect_all_filters_dropped`: For every requested study, the active dialect dropped the study filter on /observationunits, so the pull would have widened to unfiltered rows. `no_observation_path`: Neither /observations nor /observationunits returned data for any requested study after probing both paths. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

germplasmCount.description: Number of distinct germplasm in the matrix.

notice.description: Guidance for reaching the observations this call left out, then the matrix dataframe and the tools that read it.

observationCount.description: Total raw observations collected before pivoting.

shape.description: Matrix shape — wide (one row per germplasm, one column per variable) or long (one row per observation).

shown.description: Observations collected across all studies after filtering.

studies.description: Requested studyDbIds; coverage records collection outcomes.

truncated.description: True when failed, truncated, or unprocessed studies leave matrix coverage incomplete.

variableCount.description: Number of distinct observation variables in the matrix.

variableLegend.description: Wide-matrix column name (SQL-safe, derived from observationVariableDbId) → observationVariableName.

warnings.description: Advisory messages (empty or failed studies, partial study scans, extraFilters the rows contradict or cannot verify, non-numeric aggregation skips, fallback paths).

title: Brapi Build Phenotype Matrix
